Sentence (English): The dishwasher has been fantastic so far.
Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher, Documentation could be better ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher has been fantastic so far. I especially love the third rack for small items. However, the instruction manual could use some work, as it does not document what kind of threads are on the inlet connection. Ultimately, I was able to identify the threads (a type of straight pipe thread that is uncommon/nonexistent in the US) by comparing the included adapter to parts the hardware store, but that is information that should definitely be included in the installation document.Other notes:I don't have hard water, but I suspect the built in water softener makes a big difference for people that do.Although I originally did not like the idea of a Wi-Fi connected appliance, I can see how it opens up opportunities for improved user experience. However, I don't think it's being used to its full potential, yet. First, I would prefer to see the appliance connect through Bluetooth OR WiFi, so that I do not have to have the security risk it could theoretically pose by being connected to the network. Second, I don't know if Bosch intends to release software updates via the Wi-Fi connection, but that is an area that they may be able to take advantage of to improve their appliance even after purchase (assuming they can identify a change they can be applied through software only). Third, in addition to maintenance reminders like refilling rinse aid and salt, the app could provide diagnostic information in the case of appliance failures.

Sentence (English): I am generally disappointed with my new dishwasher which seems more designed for washing dinner tables rather than family dishes.
Comments (English): [ Arrangements to be reviewed urgently ] || ---------------- || I am generally disappointed with my new dishwasher which seems more designed for washing dinner tables rather than family dishes. Let me explain: First root cause: the storage space is very small compared to the volume of the tank. Bottom Space: The plate spaces are too narrow and the two bottom sizes are too close together. So the plates go up and I can only put 2 against the walls otherwise they hit the washing blades. However, the diameter of my plates is less than the maximum diameter specified. In the middle compartment, the front picks are much too tight and do not allow the items to be washed to be placed properly, apart from very small saucers. The locations for the glasses are too tilted. Unless you only use shot glasses, I don't see the point and it wastes space. Many accessories considered to be aids are ultimately little used and still take up space for nothing. The large pellet tray also wastes a lot of space. The upper basket is quite handy for all the large spoons, knives etc but the wash quality on this area is rather disappointing. Given the space problem I should have at least taken the cutlery drawer which would have allowed me to move the middle basket up a notch and save space on the bottom space to be able to put my plates. It's still tempting not to be able to put your plates in the dishwasher. The programs are generally very long. I have not yet tested the effectiveness of the short program. This may be a solution because classic programs give good washing results. The drying is quite good but does not keep the promises announced. Why not combine Zéolith and automatic opening at the end of washing. No, you have to choose one or the other with limited efficiency. Last criticism, the number of models offered each time with equipment to pay for but which in my opinion have no use. Otherwise I find my dishwasher aesthetically successful, washing is efficient, drying slightly better than my previous dishwasher. In conclusion, very good performance but a catastrophic interior design that makes every day a headache.

Du coup les assiettes remontent et je ne peux en mettre que 2 contre les parois sinon elles cognent dans les pales de lavage. Sentence (English): I may be judging this one a bit harshly because I lost a few features when I upgraded to this new Maytag.
Comments (English): [ One TINY complaint - otherwise, it's perfect! ] || ---------------- || I may be judging this one a bit harshly because I lost a few features when I upgraded to this new Maytag. I had a prior Maytag dishwasher for just a month or two shy of 24 years. I loved it. It cleaned like a dream, but because of poor choices in the tine material, they began to rust off, and it finally needed its very first repair, only to find that the parts are no longer available. After 24 years, surely there would be amazing dishwashers available and I'd be thrilled to have a new one. Well, I am ALMOST thrilled. The third rack is great. The material is no longer coated metal tines in the racks, so no worry about a tiny chip causing rust and failure of the tines over time. It's SO QUIET. I love the smooth front (controls are on top on this one) and I love that it tells me exactly how long the cycle I chose will run (short cycle is under 1 hour 15 minutes). When it's running, you rarely hear anything at all from the next room. Dishes are coming out just as clean as my old machine (which was perfect, despite its age), and I'm overjoyed about that because I have friends who actually rinse off/wash their dishes before putting them in the machine because their machines can't handle food particles. Not this machine! Get the big stuff off and toss your plates/lasagna pan right in there, and if you've loaded it correctly (dirty side getting hit by water from the spray jets) you will have spotless dishes with no handwashing necessary. Third rack is great for throwing those tiny little things that I used to put in my old machine's silverware holder (can tops for dog food, lids from my husband's travel coffee mugs, etc.). Now for the part that drives me insane. My old machine had an angled second rack (no third rack back then! ), so I could easily put very large items in the bottom rack, like my cookie sheets. You would place them on the left hand side bottom rack, and still have plenty of room on the top rack to hold bowls, glasses, etc. On this machine, I had to adjust my 2nd rack so far up that the 3rd rack made it impossible to put tall glasses in the 2nd rack and still wash my cookie sheets on the bottom rack. Why, Maytag? You were SO CLOSE to absolute perfection! I can't be the only one with very large items that need to go in the dishwasher occasionally. Overall, this thing is a 4.9 stars, so I'm giving it 5. If you frequently throw large items in your machine like I do, go check out the machine in person to make sure you have enough room. So far it's only been the big cookie sheet that gave me a fit. Absolutely everything else about this machine is amazing, and I would highly recommend it!

Sentence (English): My previous dishwasher was a very cheap, eight year old Whirlpool with rusty racks and leaks, so this was a step up.
Comments (English): [ Not Bad ] || ---------------- || My previous dishwasher was a very cheap, eight year old Whirlpool with rusty racks and leaks, so this was a step up. Sentence (English): The dishwasher that came with our home finally reached end-of-life.
Comments (English): [ Excellent and Quiet Upgrade ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher that came with our home finally reached end-of-life. It was a mid-level model and rather loud. This KitchenAid dishwasher is significantly quieter. We can and do run it any time of day. It also leaves the dishes cleaner and drier. We were not sure we'd make use of the third shelf, but we do. Some of our glasses/cups do not fit there and get positioned on the second rack. The overall rack structure allows us to position our dishes, bowls and glasses more easily and hold more than our previous washer. The only recommendation for improvement would be to enlarge the flatware slots, as many of ours do not fit.

Comments (English): [ Average dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is my second dishwasher. My GE broke after 20 years. I didn't want to spend too much and average is what I got. I've tried spreading out the dishes so that the entire dish gets sprayed and packing in the dishes where some parts of a dish is blocked by another dish. The results are roughly the same. I needed to do some pre-scrubbing to get food particles of the dish so that it comes out clean. It's not a lot of effort but it's not just throw it into the dishwasher either. IMHO it's relatively quiet and the dishes come out dry. Would I recommend? It depends on your expectation. If you don't mind the additional effort and spending a couple of hundred dollars less then I'd say go for it.

My issues are: 1. the removeable cutlery basket is now 2 smaller baskets instead of 1 large basket and they do not fit side by side on the bottom rack smoothly. They are angled and off center (see attached photos). Plus, two do not provide as much useable space as one. 2. When in use there is no way to tell how much time remaims in the cycle or when/if the cycle is complete. 3. The adjustable stemware support pieces are inefficient, take up too much space when engaged & the area underneath has very limited use. 4. There is an annoying beeping sound whenever you close the door. What purpose does it serve? 5. The quick start guide is inadequate. More complete operational instructions should be included in the delivery package.

Sentence (English): Hello!
Comments (English): [ I understand why my friend asks, “Why don’t you buy a dishwasher?” ] || ---------------- || Hello! This is 1-day 3-chicken, writing honest reviews. I hope my review will help you choose a product. The topic that I brought up the most with my friends or at Mom's Cafe after I got married was, "You absolutely have to buy it" vs. "You don't need it." The two groups were always arguing. Those who have used it say, "It's a must-have item in your life." Those who refuse to buy it say, "No matter what, it's the same." Or, "It's a waste of power and water." I was actually a person who leaned toward the "I don't need it" side, but this time, my mind completely shifted to the opposite side. In fact, my husband always said, "I used a dishwasher in the military, but it didn't clean well and was uncomfortable." Even my husband was against it, so I didn't have the strength to argue with him since I hadn't used it before. But this time, even my husband changed his mind. I think most of the people who say it didn't clean well and was uncomfortable remember the old dishwashers. It is said that in the past (about 10 years ago), there were many dishwashers that were not as good as the ones that are out now. They didn't clean well, or they consumed a lot of electricity. However, when I used it, it cleaned perfectly without any dirt, and it actually saved water compared to washing dishes with the water running. I didn't have to worry about the electricity bill at all. In fact, when I ran it for the first time, I rinsed it in water once and piled it up and ran it, but when I ran it for the second time, I rinsed it roughly and ran the dishwasher with some dirt on it, but it came out clean and squeaky clean. I regret my past kitchen life. I wish I had used it sooner. It's convenient and good. It's not worth worrying about. (I bought a solid detergent mixed with rinse from Coupang because I heard that water stains are left if you only use detergent.) The drying fan runs after use, but it's hard to completely remove the water droplets that have accumulated or collected on the top even after it's all done. When you take it out, shake it off or wipe it with a cotton cloth and put it in the cupboard. If you found my review helpful, please give it a like! I hope you always have happy things. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): This is the second dishwasher I bought.
Comments (English): This is the second dishwasher I bought. My parents' kitchen is relatively small. I bought a Hualing vie7 and put it directly on the counter. Compared with it, this w30 has a larger internal space and higher water pressure, so it does wash cleaner. Because I live in a high-rise building, the whole house has screen windows. Even in the south, I don’t worry about flying insects and cockroaches. Therefore, it is acceptable to open the door to dry, and it saves electricity. Next, let’s talk about the disadvantages: First of all, it is more difficult to place the pots. Compared with the design of vie7’s pots that can be stuck directly, it takes a lot of effort to put soup pots and the like in w30, especially our family is used to using pots instead of plates. The placement time will be longer. Secondly, the matching app page is too messy, the preference is not the device page, and the Xiaomi phone cannot connect to the dishwasher WiFi without precise positioning. I only found out after calling the customer service. Whether it is an app or a small program, when opening the electronic manual of the dishwasher, there will be a situation where you cannot jump, which is quite uncomfortable to use. In comparison, Midea’s Meiju App will be better, and of course the best one is the Mijia App. In terms of warranty, the w30 is 3 years, the Midea series dishwashers are 6 years for the whole machine, and the sub-brand Hualing is also 6 years, which is a bit worse for Haier. Finally, when paying the deposit, the estimated price displayed is 3499, but when paying the final payment, it is much higher. The plus is 3000-600 and becomes quite 3000-300. Well, it still makes me feel a little shameless to change the price even after paying an additional deposit.
Comments (Original): 这是我买的第二台洗碗机，爸妈那边厨房比较小，买的是华凌vie7，直接摆柜台上。与之相比，这台w30，内部空间更大，水压更高，确实洗的更干净。因为居住高层，全房屋都有纱窗，即使在南方也不担心飞虫和蟑螂，所以开门烘干也能接受，还比较省电。接下来说说缺点：首先，盆的摆放更加困难，对比vie7的盆可以直接卡住的设计，w30摆汤盆之类的要废一番功夫，特别是我们家习惯用盆而不是盘子，摆放的时间就要更久。其次，配套的App页面过于杂乱，首选项竟然不是设备页，小米手机在不开精确定位的情况下竟然无法连接洗碗机WiFi，我还是打了客服电话才知道的。不论是App还是小程序，打开洗碗机电子说明书的时候还会出现无法跳转的情况，用起来相当难受。对比起来，美的美居App会更好一些，当然做的最好的还是米家App。保修的话w30是3年，美的系列的洗碗机都是整机6年，子品牌华凌也是6年，这点海尔就差了些。最后，付定金的时候显示的预估价格是3499，付尾款的时候却高了不少，plus满3000-600变成了蛮3000-300，虽然预估价格不等于最终价格，但在客户选择好了的加付了定金的情况下，还更改价格还是让我觉得有点无耻。

Sentence (English): I bought my Bosch after 2.5 years of using a Whirlpool, and during one of those years, it was not in use at all, for a total of 1.5 years in use.
Comments (English): [ Better than Whirlpool, but still not perfect ] || ---------------- || I bought my Bosch after 2.5 years of using a Whirlpool, and during one of those years, it was not in use at all, for a total of 1.5 years in use. The pump had broken, which shows you the terrible quality of Whirlpool. I am happy with my Bosch and think that the price is reasonable. However, some imperfections are worth noting: it does not entirely clean out all of my smoothie cups every time I wash them, even after letting the cups soak for a little while to first loosen up the food particules. I am still figuring out if this is because of their placement in the machine during the wash. The cutlery caddy is not placed practicably on the bottom rack, as it gets in the way of big pots and pans and (I fear) could intervene with those getting thoroughly cleaned. I have not found that to be the case so far, however. A third rack for the silverware would be convenient, but that is not for this model. Finally, I have noticed that the run-times are not consistent. A heavy wash will sometimes say it is timed for 2:15:00, and other times it will say the heavy wash is timed for 2:25:00. I cannot see what makes any difference. I would say it is still a good purchase as well as with their in-brand protection plan.

Sentence (English): When my 25 year old Whirlpool dishwasher died, I wanted to replace it with another Whirlpool although with today's plastic parts and disposable mentality, I had no hope that a new one would last even a third of the previous one.

I was able to a model with Delay Start, an important feature for me, but very disappointed that the top rack design has so drastically changed. No more folding parts down to fit in larger plastic items; the entire top rack is fixed in place and the spacing is skimpy even for coffee mugs and glassware. So, the appliance for me is ok but I don't love it. Actually, I don't even like it but I will live with it. Cleans the dishes but does not dry them well—always slightly wet, even using heat dry. So—it's ok, but note to Whirlpool: if it “ain't broke” (design) , don't fix it!

Sentence (English): This is a stylish, great dishwasher, perhaps too good.
Comments (English): [ Stylish, Great Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a stylish, great dishwasher, perhaps too good. It gets so hot that it will melt any cheap plastic containers you put in it unless you turn down the heat setting. But at least you know you're dishes are sanitized! It can hold a lot of dishes if you leave the silverware basket out and use the extra top tray instead. But perhaps the best part about this dishwasher is LG's customer service. Sentence (English): My old dishwasher was 15 years old, door spring broke and touch panel was buggy but it still worked.
Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || My old dishwasher was 15 years old, door spring broke and touch panel was buggy but it still worked. I was looking to replace my dying oven, over-range microwave, and dishwasher. Next on the list, Kitchen Aid refrigerator. I was looking to go with another brand I've had years of positive experience with, but found their appliances had pretty bad reviews. Kitchen Aid was more expensive, but the reviews were outstanding. My wife loves Kitchen Aid and always wanted their appliances, plus they're American Made. This is a huge bonus, so I'm willing to absorb the added expense for a US product. One reviewer mentioned how his dishwasher was so loud, it reverberated through out the whole lower floor of his home, from the upstairs. He even went as far as recording it for youtube. I watched the video and didn't hear anything that was unacceptable. I told my family this story and after installation, the tech's ran the first cycle. After he left, we stood in front of the dishwasher and wondered what the reviewers problem was. Maybe he had a faulty unit, maybe he never worked in a restaurant. Mine is nice and quiet. All I hear is the splashing on water onto the door. It actually may be quieter than my old dishwasher. My only issue with this item is the door has a little bit of a flex to it and is not extremely rigid and solid like my old unit. which you would expect from a stainless inside and outside unit. I noticed it the very first day while opening from the edge of the handle. you could feel it. You can also grab both ends of the door and flex it, and it definitely flexes. I've mentioned it to the family and we all try to pull the door open from the middle of the handle. If the flex was apparent during manufacturing R&D, why run the handle the entire door length? Why not just put a short handle in the middle? Moving on, others mentioned during reviews that the top touch panel can be accidentally activated by touch when opening or closing the door, if you grab the top of the door or bump the button sensors with your hand. You just have to be aware of the door flex and sensitive buttons. Open from the middle of handle, close from the outside of the unit. Neither are a deal breaker, but both issues should be addressed with development of future models. Neither affect how well it cleans my dishes, and shouldn't affect longevity.

Comments (English): [ Decent Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I was expecting to be really wowed by this Bosch dishwasher. And it is a very good machine. There are some things though that are just a little annoying that I had expected would be better based on all of the reviews.First, this dishwasher was one made in Germany that were sent over due to the pandemic supply chain shortages. The dishwasher is supposed to be uber quiet at 42bd and it is fine but I think a bit louder than my former so-so LG dishwasher. The upper adjustable rack is great because you can lower it and put wine glasses on top or raise it and put trays on the bottom. This Bosch has crystal dry which does a very good job drying dishes and plastic but leaves the stainless steel drum completely wet. You cannot leave the door open just a bit to let it air dry - the door either has to be fully open or it will close. The more expensive Miele has a feature where the door pops open at the end of the drying cycle. I believe the Bosch 500 does that as well but does not have crystal dry. Lastly, I had heard that Bosch cleans pots really, really well. I had used Auto for a cycle a couple of times with pots on the bottom and glasses and bowls on top and I would say it would fully clean some of the time, sometimes there were dried pieces of food on the pots (glasses were clean). The tines on the bottom rack are not adjustable, so if you have frying pans, thick dishes or trays, they are hard to fit into the times. Is it a good dishwasher - yes. Is it worth the cost, I am not fully sure. It would be great to actually test drive different brands in advance. You have to rely on reviews and hope for the best!

Sentence (English): After reading some recommendations, I chose the Fangtai dishwasher.
Comments (English): After reading some recommendations, I chose the Fangtai dishwasher. The delivery was fast, and the customer service and installation issues were communicated smoothly. (The cabinet at my house had to remove a side panel and the upper sealing panel to fit it in). At present, the dishwasher has been used, and the oil stains are very good and can be washed very clean. There is no problem with pot lids, bowls and chopsticks, plates, and cups. The pot for cooking porridge is not very good, and it is easy to wash it uncleanly and the residue will dry in the pot after drying. The bottom left of the door panel is where the air comes out. After drying, the door will drip water. I hope there will be improvements in the future. The comprehensive use is quite satisfactory at present, and I hope to continue to optimize and continuously improve the product power.
Comments (Original): 看了一些推荐选择了方太这款洗碗机，物流很快，客服安装等问题沟通顺利，发货前还预约了师傅免费上门看能否放得下及提成改造方案。（我家里的柜子拆了一片侧板及上侧的封板才能装进去）。目前洗碗机已经使用，洗油渍很不错都能洗的很干净，锅盖，碗筷，盘子，杯子都没啥问题。煮粥的锅不太行，容易冲不干净烘干后残渣就干在锅里了。门板左下方是出气的位置，烘干后开门会滴水，希望未来能有改进。综合使用目前还是比较满意的，希望不断优化持续提升产品力。

Sentence (English): When we first bought the dishwasher we loved it.
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher broke at 1 year 9 months ] || ---------------- || When we first bought the dishwasher we loved it. We are a family of 6 and always ran a full load. We scraped rinsed plates but didn't clean perfectly them before washing and the dishes always came out beautifully clean. Fast forward to 1 year 6 months. A service repair guy came out to fix a small recall part. We had noticed that the dishwasher had gotten louder recently and was making some different noises that we hadn't heard before. I asked the repair guy about it and he said the motor was pretty loud and probably going out. He gave me a quote of $500+ to put a new one in. I said forget it since we paid around $600 for it new. We said we would keep running it and see. Maybe the motor was just going to be loud. Nope! 3 months later (now 1 year 9 months from purchase) the under-the-rack spray arm won't spin and the bottom one spins much slower. I have pulled the door open and seen that water sprays out about foot our so of the bottom spray arm, but no fast jet-like spraying anymore. We are currently still trying to use it until we can afford a new one, by using the bottom rack, but all we hear during the cycle is more of a trickling water and never the hard spray washing that should be happening. Unbelievable that a motor that fails in under 2 years is not a warranty issue. So many appliances are cheap junk anymore and all the manufacturers are getting away with it. I miss the appliances of the olden days that were actually built to work and not waste customer's money. Not buying a Maytag when we replace next month.
